Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [ACTION] Helix / ACME account overlap — propose truce + mapping sheet attached

Team —

We surfaced a non-trivial overlap between Helix (ISV partner) and our direct coverage for ACME Enterprises while reconciling Q2 pipeline. Summary: Helix has an existing integration relationship across 18 ACME business units; our SDR/AE motion has been progressing in 7 of those units (notably: SupplyOps, Merchant Experience). This creates dual ownership for opportunity DL-4821.

I've attached a mapping sheet (claim-mapping) that highlights current active deals + contacts. I think we should avoid a full escalation; instead propose a short-term truce (sales truce) with a clear split of accounts by product line and a joint mutual action plan (MAP) for the shared units.

Ask: please open with your recommended split (by BU or product), call out any active ACME POCs we should not touch, and confirm who will own the pilot accounts for the next 6 weeks. Can Marissa loop in Ethan at Helix after we align?

Quick constraints:
- Legal needs a simple addendum if we coordinate pipeline access (no license transfer).
- Dedicated routing for any inbound production requests must remain with the current owner until handoff date.

Attachments: 20270405-claim-mapping-sheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Soojin

Thanks for the ping, everyone.

Helix perspective: we value a cooperative approach. Our account team at ACME has historically covered integrations for SupplyOps and Logistics (we have delivery contracts with Logistics BU). We're ok with Redwood owning Core Inference conversations where you're the technical lead, but would ask to retain introductions and co-sell rights for the SupplyOps pilots.

2) A single point of contact from Redwood for operational escalations (we'd prefer someone from your CS/Support ops).

Subject: Re: Helix / ACME account overlap — recommended split and routing policy

Team —

Reviewed the mapping sheet and Helix's contact list. Recommendation below (short):

1) Per-product split:
   - Core Inference (ACME Core, Analytics): Redwood owns discovery + POC.
   - Edge Integrations & Connectors: Helix owns initial engagement and integration contracts.

2) Shared BU pilots (SupplyOps, Merchant Experience):
   - Owner for pilot execution: Redwood (AE: Maya), with Helix as integration lead and co-sell credit 40/60 (Helix/Redwood).
   - Intros: Helix maintains intro rights but Redwood owns technical discovery and RFP responses.

3) Routing policy: any production bug/ticket opens remain with current owner until explicit handoff. For commercial inquiries, route to the owner on the MAP.

4) Legal: propose a brief addendum (1 page) documenting the co-sell split and MAP signatures. Laura — can you confirm capacity for a quick addendum draft?

If no objections, I'll produce a one-page MAP and proposed handoff dates.

Subject: Re: Partner pipeline truce & claim synchronization — confirmed next steps

All —

Thanks for the quick alignment. Summary / agreed truce (official):

- Ownership split: Redwood = Core Inference; Helix = Edge Integrations.
- Shared BU pilots (SupplyOps, Merchant Experience): Redwood to run pilots (AE: Maya Srinivasan) with Helix as integration partner; co-sell credit 40/60 (Helix/Redwood).
- Intros: Helix keeps intro rights for existing contacts but will forward intros to Redwood for technical discovery.
- Routing & production: existing production tickets remain with the current owner until the documented handoff date.
- Legal: Laura to route a 1-page MAP addendum to both parties for signature (target: 2027-04-12).

Immediate next steps (owners & dates):
- Marissa: finalize MAP draft and share with Ethan and Jenna by EOD 2027-04-08.
- Laura: draft the 1-page addendum and send to procurement/legal on both sides by 2027-04-09.
- Jonas: produce the final account split sheet and handoff dates by 2027-04-10.
- Soojin: coordinate exec sign-off and inform CS ops of routing policy by 2027-04-11.

Attachments: 20270405-claim-mapping-sheet.xlsx, 20270405-mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf

If anyone needs to escalate, mark the Jira ALLI-321 and include me and Laura in the ticket.

Thanks — let's keep this tidy and avoid revenue friction.
